jordan.name: The Jordan River
jordan.summary: The green river valley where John baptized the crowds. Jesus was baptized here, and here John called Him the Lamb of God. John 1:28 calls the place Bethany beyond the Jordan.

wilderness.name: The Wilderness
wilderness.summary: A dry, rocky land of stones and heat. The Spirit led Jesus here, where He fasted forty days and answered every temptation with Scripture.

jerusalem.name: Jerusalem
jerusalem.summary: The holy city, with God's temple on its hill. Jesus cleared the temple, met Nicodemus at night, and was tempted on the temple's pinnacle.

galilee.name: Galilee
galilee.summary: The green hill country in the north, around the Sea of Galilee. Jesus said to Philip, “Follow Me,” and Nathanael met Jesus.

bethsaida.name: Bethsaida
bethsaida.summary: A fishing town on the north shore of the Sea of Galilee. Home of Philip, Andrew and Peter.

capernaum.name: Capernaum
capernaum.summary: A fishing town on the Sea of Galilee where Peter lived. Jesus taught in its synagogue, healed many, and called Matthew from his tax booth.

nazareth.name: Nazareth
nazareth.summary: The small hill town where Jesus grew up. When He read from Isaiah in the synagogue, His hometown rejected Him.

cana.name: Cana
cana.summary: A village in Galilee. At a wedding here Jesus turned water into wine, His first sign. Nathanael's hometown.

bethlehem.name: Bethlehem
bethlehem.summary: The town where Jesus was born.

jericho.name: Jericho
jericho.summary: An old city of palm trees in the Jordan valley. Zacchaeus climbed a sycamore tree here to see Jesus.

sychar.name: Sychar
sychar.summary: A town in Samaria near Jacob's well. Jesus offered a Samaritan woman living water, and many in her town believed.

sea-of-galilee.name: The Sea of Galilee
sea-of-galilee.summary: A large freshwater lake, also called the Lake of Gennesaret. Peter, Andrew, James and John fished here until Jesus made them fishers of men.

mountain.name: A Mountain in Galilee
mountain.summary: On a mountain Jesus prayed all night and chose the Twelve, and taught the Sermon on the Mount. The Bible doesn't name the mountain.

gerasa.name: The Region of the Gerasenes
gerasa.summary: Hills on the east shore of the Sea of Galilee. Jesus freed a man from evil spirits, and he told the whole Decapolis what Jesus had done.

hillside.name: A Hillside by the Sea
hillside.summary: A grassy hillside near Bethsaida where Jesus fed about five thousand men with five loaves and two fish.

caesarea-philippi.name: Caesarea Philippi
caesarea-philippi.summary: A town by a great rock cliff near Mount Hermon. Here Peter said, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

high-mountain.name: A High Mountain
high-mountain.summary: Jesus' face shone like the sun as Moses and Elijah talked with Him. Tradition says this was Mount Tabor.

bethany.name: Bethany
bethany.summary: A village just outside Jerusalem, home of Mary, Martha and Lazarus. Jesus raised Lazarus from the dead here.
